confidence_notes: Food and drink anchors rest on crowd-sourced Numbeo Tirana figures (undated), Saranda guide and blog ranges, and a few 2026 budget guides; sources conflict and the Saranda waterfront is typically priced above Tirana. Wine is inferred from the beer anchor, not from a direct price. Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates for July high season, not checked against live listings or booking pages. The FX observation was not verified as the latest: the only RBA figure found was 0.7088 for 2026-03-20, which is roughly eight months old relative to 2026-11-19. The server should refresh it from the RBA F11 table before use.
comparable_city_reasoning: Albanian Riviera and Ionian coastal pricing, benchmarked against Tirana cost-of-living data and adjusted upward for Saranda's waterfront and July tourist demand; accommodation benchmarked against comparable southern Adriatic and Ionian coastal towns in peak season.
